images.title: Cross multiplication: ad = bc
images.purpose: Shows that in 120 : 15 :: 80 : 10 the outer terms and the inner terms give the same product.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One proportion written large across the middle, with one arc joining the outer terms and one joining the inner terms.
images.exact_structure: Centre, large: 120 : 15 :: 80 : 10, with 120 and 10 in teal (#0072B2) and 15 and 80 in amber (#E69F00). Exactly two arcs: one teal arc above the proportion joining 120 and 10, labelled above it 120 × 10 = 1200; one amber arc below the proportion joining 15 and 80, labelled below it 15 × 80 = 1200. At the bottom, inside a thin reddish purple (#CC79A7) rounded box: ad = bc. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: In a proportion the product of the outer terms equals the product of the inner terms.
images.description: Shows that in 120 : 15 :: 80 : 10 the outer terms and the inner terms give the same product.

image_decisions.why: Arcs on the proportion make the outer and inner pairs and their equal products visible.
